  '<button class="btn-open sec" id="advCopy">📋 Salin Kueri</button></div></div></div>';
  const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
  const upd=()=>{$("advPreview").textContent=advQuery();};
  upd();
  $("advKlas").onchange=e=>{advState.klas=e.target.value;if(advState.klas){const k=KLAS.find(x=>x.id===advState.klas);$("advKw").value=k.keywords.slice(0,3).join(" OR ");advState.kw=$("advKw").value;}upd();};
  $("advKw").oninput=e=>{advState.kw=e.target.value;upd();};
  $("advPeriode").onchange=e=>{advState.periode=e.target.value;$("customDates").style.display=advState.periode==="custom"?"flex":"none";upd();};
  $("advA").onchange=e=>{advState.customA=e.target.value;upd();};
  $("advB").onchange=e=>{advState.customB=e.target.value;upd();};
  document.querySelectorAll("#advNegara .chip").forEach(c=>c.onclick=()=>{const code=c.dataset.c;advState.negara=advState.negara.includes(code)?advState.negara.filter(x=>x!==code):advState.negara.concat(code);c.classList.toggle("on");upd();});
  document.querySelectorAll("#advEngines .eng-chip").forEach(c=>c.onclick=()=>{const id=c.dataset.e;advState.engines=advState.engines.includes(id)?advState.engines.filter(x=>x!==id):advState.engines.concat(id);c.classList.toggle("on");c.innerHTML=(advState.engines.includes(id)?"☑":"☐")+" "+id;});
  ["optItu","optPdf","optId"].forEach(k=>$(k).onchange=e=>{advState[k]=e.target.checked;upd();});
  $("advRun").onclick=()=>{const q=advQuery();const sel=ENGINES.filter(e=>advState.engines.includes(e[0]));if(!sel.length){alert("Pilih minimal 1 mesin.");return;}sel.forEach((e,i)=>setTimeout(()=>window.open(e[1](q),"_blank","noopener"),i*320));};
  $("advAll").onclick=()=>{const q=advQuery();ENGINES.forEach((e,i)=>setTimeout(()=>window.open(e[1](q),"_blank","noopener"),i*320));};
  $("advCopy").onclick=()=>copyText(advQuery()).then(()=>toast("📋 Kueri tersalin."));
}

/* ============ THEME / SIDEBAR / MODAL ============ */
function initThemeSwitcher(){
  const btn=document.getElementById("btnTheme");if(!btn)return;
  const cycle=["auto","light","dark"];const meta={auto:"🌗",light:"☀️",dark:"🌙"};
  let cur=document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme-mode")||"auto";
  btn.textContent=meta[cur];
  btn.onclick=()=>{const i=cycle.indexOf(cur);const nx=cycle[(i+1)%3];cur=nx;const pd=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;const r=nx==="auto"?(pd?"dark":"light"):nx;document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme-mode",nx);document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme",r);btn.textContent=meta[nx];try{localStorage.setItem("dcTheme",nx);}catch(e){}};
}
function initSide(){
  const b=document.getElementById("btnSide");
  if(b)b.onclick=()=>{document.body.classList.toggle("side-collapsed");try{localStorage.setItem("dcSideCollapsed",document.body.classList.contains("side-collapsed")?"1":"0");}catch(e){}};
  try{const s=localStorage.getItem("dcSideCollapsed");if(window.matchMedia("(max-width:820px)").matches)document.body.classList.add("side-collapsed");else if(s==="1")document.body.classList.add("side-collapsed");}catch(e){}
}
function updateStatus(extra){
  const el=document.getElementById("acStatus");if(!el)return;
  const m=metaLoad();
  const wm=isAdmin()?(SB_WRITE_OK?"Supabase":"lokal"):"read-only";
  el.innerHTML=(extra?extra+" ":"")+"Mode: <b>"+wm+"</b> • AI: <b>"+(aiAvailable()?"aktif":"heuristik")+"</b> • Kurasi: <b>"+(m?new Date(m.at).toLocaleString("id-ID"):"belum")+"</b> • siklus <b>"+monthKey()+"</b>";
}
function initModal(){
  document.getElementById("btnCloseModal").onclick=()=>document.getElementById("keyModal").classList.remove("open");
  document.getElementById("btnSaveKeys").onclick=()=>{const g=document.getElementById("kGroq").value.trim(),o=document.getElementById("kOr").value.trim(),h=document.getElementById("kHf").value.trim(),a=document.getElementById("kAdmin").value.trim();try{if(g)localStorage.setItem("ai_groq",g);if(o)localStorage.setItem("ai_or",o);if(h)localStorage.setItem("ai_hf",h);if(a)localStorage.setItem("dcAdminToken",a);}catch(e){}_sbClient=null;location.reload();};
  document.getElementById("btnClearAdmin").onclick=()=>{try{localStorage.removeItem("dcAdminToken");}catch(e){}_sbClient=null;location.reload();};
  document.getElementById("bKeys").onclick=()=>{document.getElementById("keyModal").classList.add("open");document.getElementById("kGroq").value=localStorage.getItem("ai_groq")||"";document.getElementById("kOr").value=localStorage.getItem("ai_or")||"";document.getElementById("kHf").value=localStorage.getItem("ai_hf")||"";document.getElementById("kAdmin").value=getAdminToken()||"";};
  document.getElementById("bForce").onclick=()=>acRun(true);
}

/* ============ AUTO MODE (?auto=1) ============ */
const IS_AUTO=new URLSearchParams(location.search).has("auto");
function aoLog(msg){const el=document.getElementById("aoLog");if(el){el.textContent+="["+new Date().toLocaleTimeString("id-ID")+"] "+msg+"\n";el.scrollTop=el.scrollHeight;}}
function aoProgress(msg){const el=document.getElementById("aoProgress");if(el)el.textContent=msg;}
function aoStatus(html){const el=document.getElementById("aoStatus");if(el)el.innerHTML=html;}
window._aoLog=aoLog;
async function runAutoMode(){
  const ov=document.getElementById("autoOverlay");ov.classList.add("on");
  aoProgress("🔍 Verifikasi admin…");
  if(!isAdmin()){aoProgress("⚠️ Bukan admin.");aoLog("Tidak ada service_role key.");aoStatus('<span style="color:#ffb74d">⏸️ Bukan admin.</span>');setTimeout(()=>ov.classList.remove("on"),5000);return;}
  aoLog("Admin: ✅ • Groq: "+(localStorage.getItem("ai_groq")?"✅":"❌")+" • OpenRouter: "+(localStorage.getItem("ai_or")?"✅":"❌")+" • HuggingFace: "+(localStorage.getItem("ai_hf")?"✅":"❌"));
  aoProgress("📡 Kurasi penuh (KLAS + Indonesia + sub-pencarian)…");
  try{
    await acRun(true);
    aoProgress("✅ Selesai: "+(LAST_RUN_INFO.parents||0)+" parent + "+(LAST_RUN_INFO.subs||0)+" sub-item.");
    aoStatus('<span style="color:#5cf5a5">✅ Sukses</span>');
    aoLog("Tab ditutup dalam 5 detik…");
    setTimeout(()=>{try{window.close();}catch(e){}ov.classList.remove("on");},5000);
  }catch(e){console.error(e);aoLog("❌ "+e.message);aoProgress("❌ Gagal: "+e.message);aoStatus('<span style="color:#ff7a59">❌ Gagal</span>');}
}

/* ============ SUB-KATEGORI CLICK ============ */
document.addEventListener("click",async e=>{
  const btn=e.target.closest("[data-livesub]");if(!btn)return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const uid=btn.getAttribute("data-livesub"),url=btn.getAttribute("data-url"),kind=btn.getAttribute("data-kind");
  const panel=document.getElementById("lsub-"+kind+"-"+uid);if(!panel)return;
  const opening=panel.hidden;panel.hidden=!opening;btn.classList.toggle("open",opening);
  if(!opening)return;
  window._liveSubcatCache=window._liveSubcatCache||{};
  const cf=window._liveSubcatCache[url]=window._liveSubcatCache[url]||{};
  if(Array.isArray(cf[kind])){renderLiveSubcatPanel(panel,cf[kind],kind);return;}
  const cardEl=btn.closest(".r-card");
  const title=cardEl?.querySelector(".r-title a")?.textContent||"";
  const tags=Array.from(cardEl?.querySelectorAll(".r-tags span")||[]).map(s=>s.textContent.replace(/^#/,"")).filter(t=>!/^livecuration$/i.test(t));
  panel.innerHTML='<div class="lsub-loading">⏳ Mencari…</div>'+subcatChatAILinkHTML(kind,title,url);
  const results=await fetchLiveSubcatForItem({u:url,j:title,h:tags},kind);
  cf[kind]=results;renderLiveSubcatPanel(panel,results,kind);
  const ce=btn.querySelector(".dcount");if(ce)ce.textContent=results.length;
});
function renderLiveSubcatPanel(panel,items,kind){
  const m=LIVE_SUB_LABELS[kind];
  const title=panel.getAttribute("data-title")||"",url=panel.getAttribute("data-url")||"";
  if(!items?.length){panel.innerHTML='<div class="live-note">⚠️ Tidak ada hasil.</div>'+subcatChatAILinkHTML(kind,title,url);return;}
  panel.innerHTML=items.map(it=>subEntryHTML(it,m.cls)).join("");
}

/* ============ BOOT ============ */
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",async()=>{
  if(IS_AUTO){document.querySelector("header.hero").style.display="none";document.querySelector(".wrap").style.display="none";document.querySelector("footer").style.display="none";document.getElementById("acBanner").style.display="none";runAutoMode();return;}
  document.getElementById("pillPeriode").textContent=PERIODE.mulai+" – "+PERIODE.akhir;
  initThemeSwitcher();initSide();initModal();buildNav();
  const localData=localLoad();
  mergeLocalViews(localData);
  precomputeHay();
  goView(parseHash()||"ID");
  updateStatus();
  const before=KLAS.map(k=>k.hasil.length).join(",")+"|"+INDONESIA_VIEW.hasil.length;
  const data=await sbFetchWithSubs();
  if(data){
    mergeViews(data);precomputeHay();
    const after=KLAS.map(k=>k.hasil.length).join(",")+"|"+INDONESIA_VIEW.hasil.length;
    if(after!==before)acRefreshCurrentView();
    updateStatus("☁️ Supabase sinkron.");
  }
  if(isAdmin()){
    const m=metaLoad();
    if(!m||m.monthKey!==monthKey()||(Date.now()-(m.at||0))>12*3600*1000)setTimeout(()=>acRun(false),2500);
  }
});

};

function chartOptions(){

  return{responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false,interaction:{mode:"index",intersect:false},plugins:{legend:{display:false},tooltip:{backgroundColor:dark?"rgba(228,237,245,.96)":"rgba(15,45,68,.95)",titleColor:dark?"#0f2d44":"#fff",bodyColor:dark?"#0f2d44":"#fff",padding:10,cornerRadius:8}},scales:{x:{grid:{display:false},ticks:{color:tc,font:{size:10}}},y:{beginAtZero:true,grid:{color:gc},ticks:{color:tc,font:{size:10}}}}};

function renderChart1(){

  const d=TREND_DATA["data center"],ctx=c.getContext("2d");
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,300);g.addColorStop(0,"rgba(31,139,214,.35)");g.addColorStop(1,"rgba(31,139,214,.02)");
  _trendChart1=new Chart(ctx,{type:"line",data:{labels:d.labels,datasets:[{label:"data center",data:d.values,borderColor:d.color,backgroundColor:g,borderWidth:2.5,fill:true,tension:.35,pointRadius:0,pointHoverRadius:5}]},options:chartOptions()});
}
function renderChart2(){

  if(_trendChart2){_trendChart2.destroy();_trendChart2=null;}
  const a=TREND_DATA["AI data center"],b=TREND_DATA["liquid cooling"];
  _trendChart2=new Chart(c,{type:"line",data:{labels:a.labels,datasets:[
    {label:"AI data center",data:a.values,borderColor:a.color,borderWidth:2.5,fill:false,tension:.35,pointRadius:0,pointHoverRadius:5},
    {label:"liquid cooling",data:b.values,borderColor:b.color,borderWidth:2.5,fill:false,tension:.35,pointRadius:0,pointHoverRadius:5}
  ]},options:chartOptions()});
}
